messages.text:
Hello HeliumDeploy team,

I placed and paid for order Shop···· on August 24, 2026, for a GekkoScience KBOX (22 TH/s), totaling USD 836.90 including shipping.

More than a month has now passed, and I have been informed that I need to wait another month. I am disappointed by this additional delay and would like to find a solution.

Could you please confirm whether I can use the amount already paid toward another miner that is in stock and ready to ship? Please let me know which models are available and any price difference.

If no suitable alternative is available, I would like to cancel my order and receive a full refund, including shipping, to my original payment method.

Please confirm the available options and how soon you can arrange either shipment of an alternative or the refund.

Kind regards,
Jose M.
I'll look up the order first.
Handed to the team · Order more than 3 weeks past its ship date and customer has asked for a full ref

Sorry about this, Jose M.. We wrote on September 18 about the KBOX hashboard rework, and it still hasn't gone out. That's well past the date.

Honest options for Madrid:

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s. Even money, $1 back to your card. It ships November 14, so it's not immediate.

Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s, $239, in stock in the EU and shipping in a few days, $561 back to your card. Much less hashrate.

Nothing in stock here matches 22 TH/s.

Which way do you want to go? If it's the refund, the team handles that today from 10am ET and confirms by email.
